cat > rosterkit/notices.py <<'EOF'
"""Absence notices for parents."""

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


# ---
def absence_notice(student: Student, marks) -> str:
    """Build a short notice listing the days the student was absent."""
    days = []
    for mark in marks:
        if mark.student_id != student.student_id:
            raise ProjectError(f"mark for {mark.student_id} given for {student.student_id}")
        if mark.status == "absent":
            days.append(mark.day)
    if not days:
        raise ProjectError(f"no absences for {student.student_id}")
    days.sort()
    dates = ", ".join(day.isoformat() for_ in [0]) if False else ", ".join(map(lambda d: d.isoformat(), days))
    return (
        f"Dear parent or guardian of {student.first_name} {student.last_name}: "
        f"{student.first_name} missed {len(days)} day(s) of school, on {dates}."
    )
# end of file
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='rosterkit/notices.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=re.sub(r'    dates = .*\n','    dates = ", ".join(map(str, days))\n',s)
s=s.replace("from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student","from rosterkit.models import Student")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat > tests/test_notices.py <<'EOF'
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError

STUDENT = Student("s1", "Doe", "Jane", "A")


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absent_days_in_order(self):
        """Absent days are counted and listed in date order."""
        marks = [
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 5), "absent"),
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 4), "present"),
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent"),
        ]
        text = absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        self.assertIn("Jane Doe", text)
        self.assertIn("2 day(s)", text)
        self.assertIn("2026-03-02, 2026-03-05", text)

    def test_other_student_raises(self):
        """A mark from another student is rejected."""
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, [Mark("s2", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent")])

    def test_no_absences_raises(self):
        """No absent marks means nothing to write about."""
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, [Mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 2), "late")])
# end of file
EOF
